comparator.name: Psychology
comparator.sourceNotes: The normalized target combines the English- and Dutch-taught registrations of the same 180-EC Psychology bachelor. The official programme page states that their content is identical, with only slight possible differences in elective options. The English-taught 2026–27 regulations are therefore used as a coherent presentation of the merged target, independently of UCR fit. The programme comprises a 60-EC common first year; a 60-EC compulsory second-year major component; and a third year consisting of a 15-EC restricted Psychology differentiation component, a 15-EC bachelor thesis, and a genuine 30-EC university or personal minor. The differentiation and minor spaces are retained as choice structures rather than populated with invented selections.

routeSelection.basis: The normalized target merges the Dutch and English registrations, and the current official programme page states that their content is identical apart from slight possible elective differences. The English regulations provide the complete current curriculum in a directly usable official source; this language delivery is selected for presentation and does not narrow the academic programme.

courses: New Issues in Contemporary Social Theory

alternatives.label: Broad psychology, behaviour & research
alternatives.labelReason: The completed curriculum spans social, cognitive, biological, clinical, health and developmental psychology with quantitative and qualitative research methods.
alternatives.concept: The closest feasible UCR response to Groningen Psychology: a broad study of behaviour and mind integrating biological, cognitive, social, developmental, health and clinical psychology with research design, statistics and qualitative inquiry.
progression: Biological, behavioural, social and research foundations precede statistics, cognition, health, abnormal and developmental psychology, an advanced research seminar, psychodiagnostics and higher-level interdisciplinary study. Formal prerequisites and planned offerings pass; twelve 300-level courses are included.

alternatives.label: Clinical, health & lifespan psychology
alternatives.labelReason: This curriculum centres psychological problems, health, development, assessment and intervention while retaining biological, social and research foundations.
alternatives.concept: A clinical-and-health direction examining psychopathology, health, development across the lifespan, diagnosis, psychotherapy and resilience alongside epidemiology, physiology, pharmacology, disease mechanisms and psychological research.
progression: Behavioural, biological, social and research foundations precede statistics, cognition, health, psychopathology and development, followed by epidemiology, pharmacology, disease mechanisms, ethics and psychodiagnostics. Formal prerequisites and planned offerings pass; twelve 300-level courses are included.
alternatives.distinctness: This route makes clinical, biomedical, health and lifespan applications the organising priority. It replaces four upper-level philosophy and communication courses in the closest programme with epidemiology, pharmacology, disease mechanisms and ethics, differing by exactly four courses and 30 EC in each direction.

alternatives.label: Brain, cognition & behavioural science
alternatives.labelReason: This curriculum centres neural, biological and computational mechanisms of cognition and behaviour while preserving core psychology and research training.
alternatives.concept: A brain-and-cognition direction combining neurobiology, perception, higher-order cognition and psycholinguistics with physiology, anatomy, genetics, laboratory science, data analysis and machine learning to investigate behaviour mechanistically.
progression: Brain, behaviour, life-science and social foundations precede neurobiology, molecular biology, data, statistics, health and abnormal psychology, then laboratory science, anatomy, disease, higher cognition, machine learning, genetics and advanced psychology research. Formal prerequisites and planned offerings pass; seven 300-level courses are included.
alternatives.distinctness: This route makes neural, biological and computational explanation the organising priority. It differs from the closest programme by nine courses and 67.5 EC in each direction, and from the clinical route by seven courses and 52.5 EC in each direction.

candidates.label: Social, environmental, work & organisational psychology
candidates.rationale: This is an evidenced coherent direction, but production already reached the three-alternative maximum after the closest, clinical/health/lifespan, and brain/cognition programmes.

blocks: Both develop academic reading, writing, presenting and reflective study skills; UCR also emphasizes personal and civic formation.
Both introduce psychological theories and scientific approaches to behaviour; Groningen provides a dedicated Psychology survey and methods course.
Both examine social cognition, groups, attitudes and interpersonal influence, with Groningen adding explicit cross-cultural psychology.
Both scrutinize conceptual explanations of mind and psychological knowledge; UCR focuses philosophy of mind while Groningen treats theory of science for psychology.
Both address ethical judgment relevant to research and practice; Groningen integrates ethics directly with psychological research methods.
Both develop interpersonal communication skills; Groningen focuses dialogue and group interaction while UCR studies persuasive communication.
UCR addresses self, emotion and behaviour across courses but lacks a selected dedicated personality-and-individual-differences course.
UCR integrates historical context within courses but lacks a selected dedicated history-of-psychology module.
UCR includes social behaviour and organisational context but lacks a selected dedicated workplace-psychology course.
UCR provides professional development but lacks a selected dedicated professional-orientation course within Psychology.
Both introduce research design, measurement and statistics; Groningen continues this sequence across several dedicated courses.
Both provide practical research training; UCR focuses qualitative design, interviewing and interpretation.
Both develop statistical reasoning and experimental methods for behavioural research.
Both develop empirical data analysis; UCR adds data cleaning and visualisation while Groningen advances psychological statistics.
Both extend quantitative modelling; UCR focuses predictive machine-learning methods while Groningen advances psychological statistics.
Both integrate psychological literature, research design, analysis and reporting in an advanced applied research setting.
UCR covers psychological assessment and statistics but lacks a selected dedicated psychometric test-theory course.
The Groningen thesis is a required 15-EC empirical Psychology project; UCR optional independent research is shown in parallel as a comparison-only opportunity.
Both apply psychological theory and evidence to practical problems; UCR centres health, stress and illness.
Both examine psychopathology, classification and explanations of mental disorders.
Both examine psychological development across the lifespan.
Both address assessment and diagnosis; Groningen includes communication practice while UCR also examines psychotherapy.
Groningen requires 15 EC of restricted Psychology differentiation choices; UCR specialization is expressed through each complete selected curriculum rather than unassigned choice space.
Both examine neural and biological mechanisms underlying behaviour.
Both examine memory, attention, decision-making and higher cognition.
Both connect perceptual and neural processes to behaviour; Groningen introduces clinical neuropsychology.
Groningen retains a genuine 30-EC university or personal minor; UCR flexibility is expressed through the complete selected 180-EC programmes rather than a separate unassigned block.

notes.text: Groningen provides a prescribed Psychology sequence with dedicated statistics, test theory, diagnostic communication, professional orientation, clinical neuropsychology, a restricted differentiation component and a formal 15-EC empirical thesis. UCR can assemble substantial social, cognitive, biological, clinical, health and developmental psychology with quantitative and qualitative methods, but does not reproduce that complete professional and psychometric sequence.

selection.assessment: The closest programme integrates broad psychology with quantitative and qualitative research. Clinical/health/lifespan and brain/cognition form two further evidenced, coherent and mechanically feasible directions. Each pair differs by at least 30 EC, so production stops at the three-alternative maximum; the further evidenced social/environmental/work direction is recorded but not constructed.
